examples.english: We moved to the outskirts to live, and it’s much quieter there.
examples.traditional: 我哋搬咗去郊區住，環境清靜好多。

examples.english: I didn't want to live too far out in suburbia, so getting into the city would be easier.
examples.traditional: 我唔想住得太入郊區，出入市區都方便啲。
